faqs.q: What is the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch and what is it used for?
faqs.a: Lifting points, pad eyes and weld-on rings give a fixed or swivelling point to rig a load from. The Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch is made in alloy steel, listed in 6 sizes with size range 1.3 t to 32 t and working load limit 1.3 to 32 t.

faqs.q: How are the Indus part numbers for the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch structured?
faqs.a: IH-LR-LP-PCLC is the base part number for the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch, and each size adds a suffix: IH-LR-LP-PCLC-1P3T is the 1.3 t row and IH-LR-LP-PCLC-32T the 32 t row. Every size has its own Indus part number in the size table.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch come in?
faqs.a: The Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch is listed in 6 sizes from 1.3 t to 32 t, with a working load limit of 1.3 to 32 t. The size table also lists minimum breaking load, WLL, weight, dimensions A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H as shown on the drawing.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch?
faqs.a: Choose the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch on WLL, not on size alone: 1.3 t is rated 1.3 t and 32 t is rated 32 t. Rate the point for the load and the direction of pull. A swivel point follows the sling; a fixed eye loses capacity when pulled off its axis.

faqs.q: What is the working load limit of the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch?
faqs.a: The Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch has a working load limit of 1.3 to 32 t, depending on size, as the manufacturer rates it. The WLL is the most the part may carry in service; proof and breaking loads are test figures, never working limits. Rated with a 4:1 design factor between working load limit and minimum breaking load. Minimum breaking load is 5.2 to 128 t.

faqs.q: What is the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch made from?
faqs.a: The Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch is made from alloy steel. Finish: powder coated / zinc plated. Manufacturing: forged , cast. Ask for an alternative finish or material on the RFQ if your site needs one.

faqs.q: Does the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch come with a test certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. Each consignment of the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch ships with the manufacturer’s test certificate. For third-party certification or witnessed proof testing, say so on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What should the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch be used with?
faqs.a: The Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch gives a rigging point on the load, so pair it with a shackle sized for its eye and rated at or above the load. A related listing is the [Stainless Steel Diamond Pad Eye](/p/stainless-steel-diamond-pad-eye).

faqs.q: How should the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch be inspected and used safely?
faqs.a: Inspect the Precast Concrete Lifting Clutch before every lift and have it examined periodically by a competent person. Rate the point for the load and the direction of pull; bolted points need the stated thread engagement and torque, and weld-on points need a qualified weld to sound structure. See our [lifting equipment inspection guide](/blog/lifting-equipment-inspection-uae).

faqs.q: How should the Stainless Steel Square Swivel Pad Eye be inspected and used safely?
faqs.a: Inspect the Stainless Steel Square Swivel Pad Eye before every lift and have it examined periodically by a competent person. Rate the point for the load and the direction of pull; bolted points need the stated thread engagement and torque, and weld-on points need a qualified weld to sound structure. See our [lifting equipment inspection guide](/blog/lifting-equipment-inspection-uae).
